prediction_target.name: field-observed AM fungal hyphal length density
prediction_target.unit: metres of hypha per cubic centimetre soil

data_contract.geolocation: preserve coordinate precision and horizontal uncertainty; missing coordinates remain non-spatial rows
data_contract.depth: standardize depth interval explicitly; do not pool unmatched horizons without adjustment
data_contract.repeated_measure_policy: group all cores and repeated measures from a study/site/plot into a single holdout group

split_contract.block_size_policy: derive from training-only residual spatial autocorrelation range and freeze before test evaluation
leakage_controls: same study cannot occur in train and test
same plot/core repeated records cannot cross splits
raster covariates use matched time support where known
preprocessing and imputation fitted on training data only

geometry_to_biomass.derived_intermediate: geometric hyphal volume fraction, assuming circular cylindrical cross-sections
geometry_to_biomass.prohibited_shortcut: do not call geometric volume fraction dry biomass or carbon stock without separately calibrated tissue-density and carbon-fraction conversions

assumptions: length-density and effective-radius errors treated as independent
uncertainty_propagation.missingness: combined standard deviation is unknown if either input uncertainty is missing; missing uncertainty is never treated as zero
uncertainty_propagation.claim_boundary: geometry-only volume-fraction uncertainty; does not include radius sampling bias, branching overlap, wall/lumen, tissue density or carbon-fraction uncertainty

active_sampling.evaluation: repeat simulated field-sampling rounds on held-out spatial blocks; measure global aggregate uncertainty reduction and biome worst-stratum improvements

proposed_targets_not_results.reproduction: match the exact paper-reported outputs and uncertainty within published rounding/tolerance
proposed_targets_not_results.interval_calibration: 90 percent interval coverage within plus or minus 5 percentage points overall and in adequately sampled biomes
proposed_targets_not_results.spatial_skill: improve leave-study-out and spatial-block scores over published RF without degrading interval calibration
proposed_targets_not_results.active_sampling: at least 20 percent lower global aggregate uncertainty than random sampling at the same simulation budget
proposed_targets_not_results.worst_stratum: report sparse-biome undercoverage and OOD rather than force a global pass

claim_boundaries: modelled density does not prove continuous network connectivity
global maps do not directly observe each raster cell
geometric volume fraction is not dry biomass
biomass stock is not turnover or carbon flux
hyphal abundance is not plant nutrient delivery
a positive network-effect claim requires a distinct controlled outcome benchmark

validation_implementation.assignment: sorted study IDs distributed round-robin into deterministic approximately balanced folds
validation_implementation.spatial_training_eligibility: both geographic coordinate and sampling-depth interval required; rows lacking either remain in the catalog but are excluded from spatially supported iterator
validation_implementation.warning: study-grouped folds prevent within-study leakage but are not a replacement for spatial block or leave-biome-out holdouts
